title: 152. Concatenation of Array

examples.explanation: The array ans is formed as follows: ans = [nums[0],nums[1],nums[2],nums[0],nums[1],nums[2]] = [1,2,1,1,2,1].
The array ans is formed as follows: ans = [nums[0],nums[1],nums[2],nums[3],nums[0],nums[1],nums[2],nums[3]] = [1,3,2,1,1,3,2,1].

hints: Build an array of size 2 * n and assign nums[i] to ans[i] and ans[i + n].
